t: Flomasta PipeGrip Bent Tap Connection BN offers a push-fit water pipe solution for connecting 15mm pipe to 1/2" taps at an angle. With a dual locking system and WRAS approval, it ensures a secure, leak-free connection without the need for tools or hot works. Perfect for tight spaces and angled pipework, it provides a smooth, reliable water flow for copper and plastic pipes.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
